title: Give Me Back My Freedom
mood: A burning hall, a tilting floor, and a duel that neither side means to lose.

hero.alt: Obsidia stands calm in her burning hall, her weapon and its bone chains coiled around her.

segs.t: The throne hall was on fire. Smoke poured up between the ribs, and the floor leaned under Selena’s boots.
Obsidia stood on the slope as if it were level.
“Purification is not the end, it is where everything begins.”

blocks.caption: Purification is not the end, it is where everything begins.

segs.t: They came together again. Selena’s blade met the silver-pink weapon, and sparks flew across the burning hall.
“I don’t care about that! Give me back my freedom!”

blocks.caption: I don’t care about that! Give me back my freedom!

media.alt: Selena in white and gold armor drives in at Obsidia across the burning hall.

segs.t: She struck, and struck again.
“Sorry, but I won’t let you have your way, Obsidia.”
They broke apart. For one breath they stood face to face across the fire. Her maker’s hair was gold, like her own. They smiled the same way.
“We’re fated to destroy each other, so why were we made so alike?”
Obsidia did not answer.
Selena went in low. Her blade caught Obsidia across the cheek.
The shell split. No blood came.
Obsidia touched the cut. For the first time that day, the calm went out of her face.

media.alt: Obsidia's face up close, a thin cut across her cheek, the calm gone from her eyes.

segs.t: Her weapon came round faster than Selena could follow. It went through her and threw her into the wall. Plates cracked against her back.
Selena had walked out of every fight of her life without a scratch. This one had gone right through her.

She got her feet under her. Obsidia came on now and gave no more ground. The weapon fired, bolt after bolt, and Selena ran through them along the tilting wall. Then she turned and charged straight in.
Blade met weapon, face to face. Obsidia held it. The weapon fired once more, point-blank.

media.alt: Selena's visored face close to Obsidia's shoulder, her glowing blade held fast.

segs.t: Selena flew backward through a gap between two ribs and out of the Citadel.
She fell. Wind tore at her. The burning hull shrank above her.
Out of the smoke, Obsidia came after her, flying.
“You do not understand the true power of ‘Destruction’...”

blocks.caption: You do not understand the true power of ‘Destruction’...

media.alt: Obsidia streaks after her through a dark purple sky, trailing chains of light.

segs.t: Someone had once set her down asleep in the mud and gone back up into the clouds. Nobody was setting her down today. Selena caught herself on a bolt of her own lightning and hung there.
“Destruction and faith share the same origin.”

blocks.caption: Destruction and faith share the same origin.

segs.t: Every suit at the Academy was built from Enders,
Selena thought.
She isn’t wrong.

Then Obsidia called up her own Ender mecha suit. It closed over her: silver and gold plates, a tall crowned head. Behind her, wings of energy opened, purple and yellow, as wide as the storm. It was the strongest thing Selena had ever seen.

media.alt: Obsidia rises in a crowned suit of plate, and huge wings of magenta energy open behind her.

segs.t: “You cannot save humanity.”
Selena had never said she would.
“Every story needs an ending.”
Obsidia held out one clawed hand.

media.alt: A clawed hand of dark plate reaches out through golden light.

segs.t: “Come back, my puppet.”
“Sorry, ma’am, but I still prefer life at the academy!”

blocks.caption: Sorry, ma’am, but I still prefer life at the academy!

segs.t: The violet in Obsidia’s eyes burned brighter than it had all day.

Rain ran down Selena’s face, and the Citadel burned above her in the storm. The first thing she remembered was rain like this, and mud, and a woman’s arms, and a fruit drop in a twist of paper. Down there were the bell tower, her classroom, and a graduation she still meant to have. Selena charged.

media.alt: Selena's visor fills the frame, then she lifts her blade and charges at the winged figure.
